item.title: Splitting the Zabbix Database
item.description: For high-concurrency enterprise Zabbix scenarios — move the database off the Zabbix server onto a dedicated MariaDB server (11.0.1.52): create the database and grant privileges, export and import the data, update the Web UI and Server database connection settings, then restart the services.
